struct Point {
    double x, y;

// Function to calculate the cross product of vectors OA and OB
double crossProduct(const Point& O, const Point& A, const Point& B) {
    return (A.x - O.x) * (B.y - O.y) - (A.y - O.y) * (B.x - O.x);
}

// Function to compare two points based on their polar angle with a reference point
bool polarCompare(const Point& p1, const Point& p2, const Point& ref) {
    double cross = crossProduct(ref, p1, p2);
    if (cross == 0)
        return (p1.x * p1.x + p1.y * p1.y) < (p2.x * p2.x + p2.y * p2.y);
    return cross > 0;
}

// Function to find the lower tangent between two convex polygons
std::pair<int, int> findLowerTangent(const std::vector<Point>& poly1, const std::vector<Point>& poly2) {
    int i1 = 0, i2 = 0;
    while (true) {
        if (crossProduct(poly1[i1], poly1[(i1 + 1) % poly1.size()], poly2[i2]) <= 0)
            i1 = (i1 + 1) % poly1.size();
        else
            i2 = (i2 + 1) % poly2.size();
        if (i1 == 0 && i2 == 0)

    }
    return {i1, i2};
}

// Function to find the upper tangent between two convex polygons
std::pair<int, int> findUpperTangent(const std::vector<Point>& poly1, const std::vector<Point>& poly2) {
    int i1 = 0, i2 = 0;
    while (true) {
        if (crossProduct(poly1[i1], poly1[(i1 + 1) % poly1.size()], poly2[i2]) >= 0)
            i1 = (i1 + 1) % poly1.size();
        else

#include <omp.h>

void luFactorize(std::vector<double> &A, size_t N) {
    #pragma omp parallel for collapse(2)
    for (size_t k = 0; k < N; ++k) {
        // Upper triangular part
        for (size_t j = k; j < N; ++j) {
            double sum = 0.0;
            for (size_t p = 0; p < k; ++p) {
                sum += A[k * N + p] * A[p * N + j];

void ifft(std::vector<std::complex<double>> &x) {

    if (N <= 1) return;

    // Bit-reversal permutation
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
        int j = reverse_bits(i, static_cast<int>(std::log2(N)));
        if (i < j) std::swap(x[i], x[j]);

                int q = p + m / 2;
                std::complex<double> t = w * x[q];
                x[q] = x[p] - t;
                x[p] += t;
            }
            w *= std::complex<double>(std::cos(theta), std::sin(theta));

    }

        val /= N;

    }
